thread:
Priya: Quick check — planning a very narrow canary for model_v7 today. intent: 2% NA, 1% EU, and 100 internal org/dev users. Keeping token-limits identical to v6. Need quick 👍 and any objections.

Ben: Sounds good. Do we have fallback mapping if v7 trips? (ie auto-fallback to v6)

Priya: yes — rollout policy will fallback to model_v6 when errors > 0.5% for 5m or latency p95 > 900ms for 3m. Will add that to the flag config.

Alex: Can you paste the flag snippet here? I want to review the audience rules.

Priya: pasted below — this is the planned flag used by the router:
```
feature: model_v7_canary
rules:
  - audience: internal_team
    percent: 100
  - audience: geo_na
    percent: 2
  - audience: geo_eu
    percent: 1
fallback: model_v6
slo_triggers:
  error_rate: 0.5
  latency_p95_ms: 900
cooldown: 300  # seconds before auto-retry
```

Jamie: nit: add a guard for heavy-context requests — cap sequence_len > 2048 -> route to v6; saves risk for long prompts.

Priya: good call. I'll add that rule. Also enabling prefix caching for v7 disabled for now (:no_cache:).

Ben: Ops question — who will watch the 1st hour? I can take 0-2pm PT. Need an oncall handover note if we hit fallback.

Priya: assigning to Ben for first hour. Alex can take 2-4pm PT. I'll update the oncall rota and the incident channel.

Alex: FYI, I'll add a quick smoke test script to the canary job — will run 50 short prompts + 10 long prompts and assert no output regressions. I'll post results to #eng-ml and tag @Priya.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: model_v7_canary flag update -> staging -> canary slices. Run id: dpl_2026_03_17_42.

Jamie: small request — add a metric check for hallucination-rate increase (we have a quick heuristic in evals svc). If >0.3% over baseline for any slice, trigger alert.

Priya: will wire hallucination heuristic into the rollout monitors. After canary stabilizes for 2h we'll increase NA -> 10% and EU -> 3% per plan. No objections so far?

Ben: :+1: all good from infra side.

Alex: :eyes: waiting on smoke test results before thumbs up for ramp.

Priya: thank you — I'll hold the ramp until tests + 1h stable. Posting the final config and timeline in #eng-platform before flip.
